receipt.public_excerpt: OpenAI, the creator of ChatGPT, expects about $5 billion in losses on $3.7 billion in revenue this year, CNBC has confirmed.

evidence_items.explanation: OpenAI, the leading generative AI company, expected to lose more than it took in during 2024. That is 'burning money to make money'.

metric_scope.metric: Expected net loss for the year (excluding equity-based compensation)

evidence_items.publisher: OfficeChai (summarising Reuters report on Anthropic IPO prospectus)
evidence_items.locator: section 'The $42 Billion Net Loss, Explained', bullet 1

receipt.public_excerpt: Operating loss: $8.06 billion in 2025, up from $2.98 billion in 2024

evidence_items.explanation: Anthropic, the other company named in the passage, had an operating loss of about $3 billion in 2024. The figure comes from its prospectus as reported by Reuters.

receipt.public_excerpt: OpenAI forecasting revenue will more than triple in 2025 to $11.6 billion and eventually reach $100 billion in 2029.

evidence_items.explanation: OpenAI told investors it had a growth plan, which bears on 'no clear path'. These are revenue projections, not demonstrated profits, so they do not contradict the burning-money core.

unresolved_gaps: Whether OpenAI or Anthropic had a 'clear path' to profit is a judgment. Company projections exist, but they are not proof either way.
The OpenAI figure is a mid-year company projection reported by the press, not audited results. The Anthropic figure comes from a secondary summary of a prospectus reported by Reuters.
